title: add_control inputSchema
description: Argument shape for add_control (composition profile, ADR-0031). Adds or replaces (by control id) one control in a composition document's `controls` collection. The standard-level target is a composition document (mapPackageId or appPackageId). The reference implementation authors compositions through a draft lifecycle; its optimistic-concurrency draft spelling (draftId + generation) is admitted as x-honua-reference-shape, consistent with ADR-0030's bind_interaction and ADR-0029's admission of reference spellings. Validation gate: control.id must be unique within the document, control.kind must be a member of the closed vocabulary, and a control.sourceId must resolve to a layer or datasource declared in the target document. See docs/adr/0031-composition-controls.md and common/controls.schema.json.

mapPackageId.description: Target MapPackage composition document. Exactly one of mapPackageId / appPackageId / draftId identifies the target.

appPackageId.description: Target AppPackage composition document. Exactly one of mapPackageId / appPackageId / draftId identifies the target.

draftId.description: x-honua-reference-shape: reference-implementation draft-lifecycle target. Requires generation.

generation.description: x-honua-reference-shape: optimistic-concurrency generation of the draft being mutated; the call fails on generation conflict.

control.description: The control to add or replace. Replacement matches on control.id.
